- **Q1 2024:** The 10-Q says operating income was $2,141 million for the three months ended March 29, 2024. That quarter was held down by items impacting comparability.
- **Q4 2024:** The Q4 release says operating margin was 23.5% versus 21.0% in the prior year for the quarter. I applied 23.5% to Q4 net revenues of about $11,544 million, which I recalled from memory and did not retrieve. That gives roughly $2,712 million. It is consistent with the reported 19% year-over-year growth, which implies about $2.7 billion.
- **Change:** 2,712 ÷ 2,141 − 1 ≈ +26.7%.
